intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both sit in {{cityA}}, and this page compares their recorded {{course}} fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in {{year}}.
ICFAI University Raipur vs IIM Raipur is not a single winner. IIM Raipur has a recorded NIRF 2025 #15, and ICFAI University Raipur has no NIRF rank on this page.

sections.heading: ICFAI University Raipur vs IIM Raipur for MBA / PGDM: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose ICFAI University Raipur if you want a 2024 flagship package record of ₹4 LPA, and a recorded fee of ₹1.3 lakh, in a private MBA / PGDM setting at Raipur.
Choose IIM Raipur if you want a recorded NIRF 2025 #15, and a recorded fee of ₹15.63 lakh, in a public MBA / PGDM setting at Raipur.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip short, executive or certificate rows when the picker can tell them apart. Always match the fee to the exact programme you will join.
Our records show ₹1.3 lakh as a programme total for MBA Banking at ICFAI University Raipur.
IIM Raipur's official MBA 2026-28 fee page lists a two-year total of ₹20.08 lakh, excluding caution deposit, boarding and medical insurance.
Our recorded figure for IIM Raipur is ₹15.63 lakh on Post Graduate Programme (PGP). Check it against the official notice before you decide.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: ICFAI University Raipur's latest recorded flagship year here is 2024, with an average of ₹4 LPA and a highest package of ₹9 LPA on MBA Banking. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.
We do not hold a 2020-or-later flagship placement year for IIM Raipur here, so do not treat older or unofficial packages as current.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Our records do not list a confirmed entrance exam for ICFAI University Raipur on this page. Use the institute's current admission notice rather than last year's cut-off stories.
IIM Raipur is listed on our records with CAT as an admission route for this MBA / PGDM comparison. Confirm the current brochure for cut-offs, interviews and any extra institute test.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in {{cityA}}, Chhattisgarh. If you want to stay in this city, the choice is less about relocation and more about the classroom, fees and the admission route.
ICFAI University Raipur is listed as a private institute and IIM Raipur as a public institute on our records. That difference can affect fees, seat reservations and campus culture.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you want a documented flagship placement year, ICFAI University Raipur is the clearer record here, because IIM Raipur has no 2020-or-later flagship package on this page.
Use official fee notices rather than our raw minimums, then decide whether IIM Raipur's recorded ₹15.63 lakh or ICFAI University Raipur's ₹1.3 lakh fits your budget for this MBA / PGDM.
If fees are the only filter, do not use the lowest number in our raw rows. Check each official fee notice for the exact programme and batch you will join.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, ICFAI University Raipur or IIM Raipur?
faqs.answer: It depends on the programme you want.

faqs.question: What are the recorded fees for ICFAI University Raipur vs IIM Raipur?
faqs.answer: our records list ₹1.3 lakh for ICFAI University Raipur on MBA Banking; IIM Raipur's official MBA 2026-28 fee page lists a two-year total of ₹20.08 lakh, excluding caution deposit, boarding and medical insurance. Confirm both official notices before you decide.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for ICFAI University Raipur and IIM Raipur?
faqs.answer: ICFAI University Raipur's latest recorded flagship year here is 2024, with an average of ₹4 LPA and a highest package of ₹9 LPA on MBA Banking. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.

faqs.question: Which entrance exams do ICFAI University Raipur and IIM Raipur accept?
faqs.answer: Our records list no listed exam on this page for ICFAI University Raipur, and CAT for IIM Raipur. Always confirm the current admission brochure, because tests and cut-offs change by year.

faqs.question: Are ICFAI University Raipur and IIM Raipur in the same city?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are in Raipur, Chhattisgarh. The move is about the programme, fees and tests, not a change of city.

faqs.question: Should I treat this comparison as a final admission decision?
faqs.answer: No. Fees, eligibility and placements change by year and by programme. Verify the current official fee notice, admission brochure and placement report of each institute before you apply.
